MonoBrowser 0.7.0

- Chrome extensions: install them straight from the Chrome Web Store ("Add to MonoBrowser"); installed extensions update automatically
- Extension buttons and popups in the toolbar, in every layout (horizontal, vertical sidebar on either side, compact mode)
- New extensions page (`monobrowser://extensions`, also in the menu, Settings → Browsing and the command palette): enable, disable, remove, open options, allow in private mode, load unpacked extensions, open the extensions folder
- Extensions that need APIs MonoBrowser doesn't support are marked "Limited compatibility"
- Extension items in the page context menu, and pop-out windows for extensions such as Bitwarden
- When a working content blocker extension (uBlock Origin Lite, AdGuard, …) is installed, the built-in ad blocker steps aside; it comes back when the extension is disabled or removed
- Links opened with a middle click now open in a background tab
- Fixed an error when closing a tab showing an extension page

Known limitations: keyboard shortcuts defined by extensions are not supported yet.

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.7.0.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.7.0-x86_64.AppImage`
